item.description:
Ingest 0.9.9

  • Set up a workspace faster: choose Build from scratch, Events, Headshots, or Real Estate, and see the folders, filenames, and import questions before using it.
  • Folder setup asks plain questions: a folder for each import, empty folders for later (such as Originals, Edits, and Final Exports), which files you usually import, and whether to make a backup.
  • Questions are asked only when a name uses the answer, and the builder shows exactly what you will be asked at import.
  • Naming variables sit on the line with your text, start with Photo Number, and include a “What do the variables mean?” reference.
  • Share selected photos or folders through Messages or Email, with optional ZIP attachments.
  • Preview RAW photos with their Adobe edits. Requires Adobe DNG Converter.
  • Tags, ratings, and Organize drafts survive unplugging and reconnecting a drive.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.8.2

  • Fix clipped controls in Organize Photos setup, with clear Copy, Move, and Rename in Place choices and readable long folder paths.
  • Remove oversized orange focus outlines when opening dialogs or clicking controls. Keyboard navigation uses a subtle indicator around the focused option instead of the entire group.
  • Keep keyboard focus indicators independent between windows and avoid duplicate button outlines.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.

Ingest 0.9.8.1

  • Set up separate Import and Organize destinations, folder structures, and filename patterns within one workspace.
  • Build folder and file names with ordinary text and readable variables. Type a brace to find variables directly, including in custom Import settings.
  • Use Import Date, Today’s Date, or Capture Date in names. Import-date folders can hold photographs taken across multiple days.
  • Choose Copy, Move, or Rename in Place when starting an Organize task, then review the proposed changes before applying them.
  • See import progress automatically, with copy and verification bars, current activity, and clear completion results. Continue browsing while an import runs.

Requires macOS 15 or later and an Apple silicon Mac.
